chunks: Yunus narrated from Zur'ah from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a Muslim man, does he inherit the polytheist? He said: 'Yes, and the polytheist does not inherit the Muslim.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq
key_terms.ٱلْمُشْرِك: the polytheist (one who associates partners with God)

ai.seo_question: Does a Muslim inherit from a non-Muslim polytheist according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the asymmetry in inheritance between Muslims and polytheists, a foundational principle in Shia fiqh derived from the Quranic verse 8:75. It underscores that while a Muslim retains the right to inherit from a non-Muslim relative, the reverse is precluded due to the superiority of faith, a ruling consistently upheld by the Ahl al-Bayt in their juristic deductions.
